RENEWING A MATERIAL'S GEOMETRIC REFERENCE UNDER LOAD
1 November 2026. Fresh physical-technology investigation.

STATUS AND PRECISE OBJECTIVE

The intended consequence is precision structures that can replace worn material
without gradually forgetting their stress-free geometry. Such a capability would
matter for machines, instruments, manufactured infrastructure and eventually
actively maintained materials. This investigation does not establish a
civilisation-changing technology, historical priority, or a complete resource
advantage. It develops and tests a conditional physical construction, eliminates
several attractive shortcuts, and makes the remaining reference-maintenance
problem quantitative.

The positive construction copies a member's NATURAL LENGTH, while it is carrying
load, from two current surviving members. It uses force comparison, a finite
physical observation protocol, and powered rest-length adjustment. No particular
member must remain an intact geometric master. The initial target information
still resides in manufactured physical references; it has not been created from
fuel. Junctions, controller, delivery equipment, sensors and actuators have finite
costs and failure channels. Full autonomous replacement of all of that equipment
is NOT supplied by the member-level construction.

Three scopes must remain distinct:
  (a) exact conditional mathematics and finite-state/linear-model calculations;
  (b) executable numerical evidence using declared, mostly illustrative parameters;
  (c) experimental material performance, which was not acquired.

The earlier sensor and thermal-mediator research is preserved unchanged in the
prior archive. No quantum-information capability is the objective of this run.


1. FIRST CANDIDATE AND WHY IT WAS NOT SELECTED

Before targeted primary or Astra retrieval, the candidate was a heterogeneous
material with geometry-dependent protection of reversible bonds. Locally correct
closure would protect a part; strained or incompatible closure would leave it
exchangeable. Chemical fuel could drive replacement. The root recorded this in
materials_candidate_first_principles.txt. An independent constructor received the
capability and physical constraints, not this preferred mechanism.

CONSERVATION THROUGH PHYSICAL REPLACEMENT

Scope. This is an accounting and representation audit, not a universal
impossibility theorem. No new literature search or numerical experiment was
needed. A physical conservation law can correlate errors without measurement;
one must establish that the law survives export of the worn carrier and that
the conserved quantity actually determines natural length.

1. Exact live-carrier accounting

Before renewal, the live reference carriers are old a and survivors j. Let
S_minus = r_a + sum_j r_j. The incoming physical carrier b initially has natural
length r_b0. After all interactions, b has r_b_plus, the survivors have changed
by Delta_j, and a is exported. Then, identically,

S_plus - S_minus = r_b_plus - r_a + sum_j Delta_j.              (1)

Thus zero-sum changes among the survivors are insufficient. Conservation of
the live sum requires the new carrier plus the surviving changes to receive
the old carrier's contribution:

r_b_plus + sum_j Delta_j = r_a.                               (2)

Even if an ideal physical interaction conserves the sum of natural-length
coordinates of ALL carriers, incoming and outgoing included, its consequence
is only

S_plus - S_minus = r_b0 - r_a_out - Delta R_aux,               (3)

where R_aux denotes any additional carrier of that conserved coordinate.
With no auxiliary carrier, live-sum conservation requires r_a_out = r_b0.
For example, a perfect state SWAP r_b_plus = r_a, r_a_out = r_b0 works.
It transfers the unknown analog state; an explicit measurement is not a
logical necessity. Merely retaining conservation in the larger system while
discarding a does not work. The discarded carrier can export the reference.

2. What independent overwrite noise hides

If t is the desired newcomer value, r_b_plus = t + eta, then conservation
requires sum_j Delta_j = r_a - t - eta. If r_a = t, the write error eta must
be accompanied by exactly -eta in the surviving reference carriers. Such
correlation can come from a real pairwise exchange event or holonomic
constraint; projecting a sampled noise vector to zero sum does not construct
either. If the old member is damaged, r_a = t + d, conserving the CURRENT sum
transfers d into the surviving carriers instead of correcting it.

# Conserved or quantized reference: focused challenge

**Verdict:** A representation change can eliminate the specific repeated analog-copy random walk. It does not eliminate inventory-transfer faults or the uncertainty of converting the invariant back into length. The strongest conventional route is a protected integer register plus a freshly realized physical pitch. A closed hydraulic inventory is a useful physical alternative but conserves mass, not geometry.

## Exact distinction

Replace the recursively copied analog state by

\[
Q_{j+1}=Q_j+\delta q_j,\qquad R_j=g(Q_j,\theta_j)+\epsilon_j,
\]

where Q is a conserved inventory or corrected discrete value and theta contains the transducer's current material, temperature, pressure and calibration state. If delta q is exactly zero and theta/epsilon have a bounded stationary distribution, the output error has a bounded floor instead of accumulating the previous cycle's analog error. Linearizing gives

\[
\operatorname{Var}(R_M)\simeq g_Q^2 M\sigma_{transfer}^2+
\operatorname{Var}(g_\theta\delta\theta_M+\epsilon_M).
\]

A systematic inventory loss b produces a bias proportional to M b. If theta itself is maintained only by analog copying, the random walk has merely moved into theta.

## Strongest conventional construction

Quantize the original scalar as N=round(R0/a0), store N in a finite error-corrected integer memory, and manufacture or position the new member using N periods of a newly realized crystalline or interferometric pitch. During replacement, decode the integer, verify the replacement copy, and then retire the old copy. All storage components can turn over; no single geometric artifact must survive. The initial quantization cost is at most a0/2. The memory, majority/decoding apparatus, readout, verification, and energy are real parts, not free helpers.

Conditional on correct logical transfer,

\[
R_M=N a_M+\epsilon_M,
\quad
R_M-R_0=(N a_0-R_0)+N(a_M-a_0)+\epsilon_M.
\]

There is no inherited M sigma_copy^2 term. The remaining error is quantization, current pitch calibration and current setting error.
